lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new screens, as only one test has been completed so far.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measured results.

candidates.title: Pet Personality Builder Screen
candidates.change: Add a personality quiz screen before pet selection to let users customize companion behavior traits.
candidates.why: The adoption stage drops to 66.2% conversion with a high median time (89s); offering interactive personality customization increases engagement.

new_personality_quiz.headline: What is your companion's vibe?
new_personality_quiz.body: Select personality traits to tailor how your pet behaves on your desktop.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a new personality quiz screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses 33.8% users, but adding a new adoption screen yielded negative results (-0.4%) in prior testing.

candidates.title: Choose Path Grid Showcase
candidates.change: Redesign choose_path screen with a grid layout displaying vibrant companion preview cards for each path.
candidates.why: choose_path mean time is high (514s) despite an 8s median, showing some users hesitate; a clear grid visual accelerates decision-making.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Journey
choose_path.body: Choose whether to adopt a pre-made pet or create a custom pet companion.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Interactive Quick Control Cards
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro with spotlight cards highlighting pet shortcuts, dragging, and desktop controls.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple emails about post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the desktop pet.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Here is how to summon, move, and interact with your pet on your desktop.

home_welcome.text: Click pet to interact | Drag to move | Right-click for options menu

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a tip_carousel cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Generation Progress Mascot Screen
candidates.change: Insert an animated pet loading screen while desktop pet assets prepare in the background.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s; adding a lively interim screen prevents perceived stall and drop-off.

waiting.hint: Preparing your desktop pet's animations and sounds...

new_pet_loading_stage.headline: Waking Up Your Pet...
new_pet_loading_stage.body: Your pet is getting ready to jump onto your desktop screen!

guard.reason: Valid addition of an animated mascot screen after the waiting step.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long mean delay in home step, but requires building a full new screen.

candidates.title: Sign In Data Persistence Assurance Copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body to emphasize that logging in preserves desktop pet progress across restarts.
candidates.why: Support logged 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in has a 567s mean time.

sign_in.headline: Save & Sync Your Desktop Pet
sign_in.body: Sign in to keep your pet, items, and progress synced securely across all your desktop devices.
sign_in.hint: Using the same account ensures your pet is never lost.

guard.reason: Valid copy update on sign-in screen without violating pricing or fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Both support emails (8 logs) and funnel mean time point to this issue; simple copy change.

candidates.title: Background Pet Preparation Tip Carousel
candidates.change: Add an interactive tip carousel to the waiting screen explaining desktop controls while files compile.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, and support notes user confusion regarding desktop features after setup.

wait_status.text: Did you know? You can drag your pet anywhere on your screen or minimize it to the tray.

guard.reason: Waiting screen update retains indication that pet is being created.

candidates.score_note: Funnel metrics and support notes both highlight wait time and control confusion.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Guidelines Hint
candidates.change: Display explicit lighting and clarity tips on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: Support reported 3 tickets where custom pet generation failed or looked wrong, hurting adoption conversion (66.2%).

upload_photos.hint: Use bright lighting and clear front-facing photos for best 3D pet generation results.

photo_upload.text: Supported formats: JPG, PNG. Avoid blurry photos.

guard.reason: Asks for personal information by requesting photos of the user.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Name Preview
candidates.change: Add a pet name input field and digital companion badge preview to the adoption certificate.
candidates.why: Adoption stage takes a mean 1017s; reinforcing immediate ownership and emotional connection accelerates completion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Give your desktop companion a unique name to seal the adoption!

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.certificate[0]': a name_input cannot do the certificate job (use ['animation', 'badge', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Path Selection Estimated Time Notification
candidates.change: Show estimated total onboarding completion time and step counters during path selection.
candidates.why: choose_path step exhibits a high mean time (514s), indicating user uncertainty regarding setup length.

choose_path.hint: Takes less than 2 minutes to complete your pet adoption!

guard.reason: Creates urgency to complete the onboarding process quickly.

candidates.title: Home Welcome Desktop Checklist Layout
candidates.change: Switch home_intro layout to a checklist detailing first interactions with the new pet.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is low at 19.4%, and the finish step conversion is 64.8%; clear action items improve completion.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion Has Arrived!
home_intro.body: Complete these quick steps to get started with your pet on your desktop screen.

home_welcome.text: 1. Feed your pet | 2. Try dragging pet | 3. Minimize to system tray

guard.reason: text in 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0].text' has characters outside the allowed set: ['|']
